Long one. Back from Lisbon last night, and a lot happened in the week before it.

## Daan

We broke up on Tuesday 25 March. Or, he said what I'd been thinking since January: we want different cities. He's taking the job in Eindhoven at the ASML supplier (Prodrive), he starts 1 May, and I am not moving to Eindhoven. Five years. No shouting, which almost made it worse. We sat on the bench at the Amstel by the Magere Brug for two hours and then went home and ordered pizza like nothing happened.

He moves out on 26 April. Van booked, €89 from MacIntosh Verhuur. We split the couch question with a coin. I kept the couch.

## Telling people

- Salma: cried more than me. Then made me promise to come for dinner every Thursday in April.
- Mama: "I knew." Of course she did.
- Noor: booked flights to Lisbon within the hour. That's Noor.
- Work: told Henk only, Friday. He gave me Monday off without asking why.

## Lisbon with Noor

28 to 31 March. Eid fell on Sunday the 30th, so we had Eid breakfast at a pastelaria in Alfama, which is the weirdest and nicest Eid I've had. Mostly followed the plan in [[Lisbon long weekend]], skipped Sintra because it rained sideways.

- Stayed at Casa do Largo, Graça, €142/night split two ways
- Tram 28 at 08:10 before the crowds, worked
- Time Out market was a mistake, packed
- Best food: grilled sardines at O Velho Eurico, €17 each with wine for Noor
- Miradouro da Senhora do Monte at sunset, both of us quiet for a long time

## Packing

Carry-on only, again. Followed [[Packing list carry-on]] and still forgot a charger. Bought a €19 one at the airport, annoying.

## Money

Breakup costs nobody tells you about: the flat is now €1,640/month on my own instead of split. Need to redo the [[Budget spreadsheet]] this weekend. The €600 a month savings goal from January is probably €350 now.

## What I'm reading

Noor gave me Seneca's letters on the plane, said "this is your style, it's basically a PM writing to a friend". Started doing a morning thing from [[Stoicism daily practice]]: write what's in my control and what isn't, 5 min, before the laptop. Day 3 today. In my control: the flat, running, the Atlas date discussion. Not in my control: Eindhoven.

## Work this week

Atlas staging demo on 11 April, slot picker still buggy. Jens' team in a good rhythm. Glad of the distraction honestly.

## Mood

Monday I was a 4. Today maybe an 8? Lisbon helped. Noor helped more.
